title: Monsoon Fishing Bans for Indian Marine Fisheries
citation: MPEDA Official Notice, May 28, 2026. Available at: https://mpeda.gov.in/?page_id=589
regulatory_basis: Indian Marine Fisheries Regulation Act; Sustainable Fisheries Management
scientific_basis: Monsoon-driven breeding season for key commercial species; essential for stock replenishment

bans.reason: Southwest monsoon breeding season; habitat protection
bans.enforcement: MANDATORY - All commercial trawling prohibited. Violators subject to vessel seizure, ₹5-10 lakh fines

bans.status: ACTIVE (currently in effect Aug 15, 2026 - past ban)
bans.reason: Southwest monsoon breeding season; nursery ground protection
bans.enforcement: MANDATORY - All commercial trawling prohibited. Violators subject to vessel seizure, ₹5-10 lakh fines
bans.note: Earlier than West Coast; initiated Apr 15, ends Jun 14

historical_compliance.penalties_2025: Total ₹4.2 crore in fines; 20 vessels permanently de-registered

export_impact.compliance_requirement: All shipments must have catch date documentation proving non-ban-period origin
export_impact.verification_method: Landing Centre receipt + Vessel GPS logs + RCMC certification
export_impact.scoring_impact: MONSOON COMPLIANCE pillar = 0 points if catch during ban period = AUTO-BLOCK

regulatory_notes.authority: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying
regulatory_notes.exceptions: Artisanal fishing with small nets permitted in some states; mechanized trawling strictly prohibited
regulatory_notes.updated_frequency: Annually (typically announced in April-May for upcoming season)
